The structure of MgV2Si2O8 crystallizes in the orthorhombic space group Amm2 (No. 38), with 13 atoms in the unit cell distributed over six independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis identifies octahedral coordination for Mg, Si, and V centers: each Mg and Si center has six O neighbors, while V is octahedrally coordinated by six O atoms. Corner-sharing is observed between Mg and Si octahedra, Mg and V octahedra, Si and V octahedra, and between V octahedra, with an additional edge-sharing relation between Mg octahedra. The geometric neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all 13 sites.
